title: zizmor rejected a pinned GitHub Action with a known vulnerability
summary: The workflow audit (zizmor, online mode) reported GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 for pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2 at publish.yml lines 86 and 106.
recommendation: Update the pinned action to the patched release (by commit SHA) and run zizmor online locally before pushing workflow changes.
evidence: Workflows (actionlint + zizmor)	Run zizmor	2026-11-01T20:16:34.4483985Z ##[error]publish.yml:86: action has a known vulnerability: GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9
Workflows (actionlint + zizmor)	Run zizmor	2026-11-01T20:16:34.4493662Z ##[error]publish.yml:106: action has a known vulnerability: GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9
root_cause: Commit e651c26 added .github/workflows/publish.yml pinned to pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish v1.14.2, which is affected by the critical advisory GHSA-5xjx-3w67-w9x9 (fixed in v1.14.3); the local zizmor run was offline and did not check advisories.

fix.description: Commit b086262 pinned pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish to v1.14.3 (7245906fb61fa33a13554f9d5fb856fe61758086).
